pages.text: Refined Storage 2 introduces a completely revamped autocrafting system with improved performance and new features. The core of this system is the new Autocrafter block.$(br2)Key Components:$(br)$(li)Pattern Grid - For creating crafting patterns$(li)Autocrafter - Executes crafting operations$(li)Autocrafting Monitor - Tracks crafting progress$(li)Autocrafter Manager - Manages multiple autocrafters

The Pattern Grid:$(br)$(li)Create crafting and processing patterns$(li)Supports both regular crafting and machine processing$(li)Improved pattern validation$(li)Better item type handling$(br2)Patterns now have clearer indicators for crafting vs processing modes and better error detection.

The Autocrafter:$(br)$(li)More efficient than RS1's Crafter$(li)Better parallel processing$(li)Improved resource management$(li)Smarter crafting queue$(br2)Multiple Autocrafters can work together seamlessly for complex crafting operations. The system automatically balances crafting tasks across available Autocrafters.

Processing Patterns:$(br)$(li)Enhanced machine integration$(li)Better fluid handling$(li)Improved byproduct management$(li)Clearer processing visualization$(br2)RS2 handles complex processing chains more efficiently, with better support for modded machines and fluid processing.

Monitoring & Management:$(br)The Autocrafting Monitor provides real-time information about:$(br)$(li)Current crafting tasks$(li)Resource availability$(li)Crafting progress$(li)Error states$(br2)The Autocrafter Manager allows you to:$(br)$(li)View all patterns in your network$(li)Manage crafting priorities$(li)Monitor resource usage

Performance Improvements:$(br)RS2's autocrafting system features:$(br)$(li)Reduced network impact$(li)Better CPU utilization$(li)Improved memory management$(li)Smarter scheduling$(br2)These improvements make large-scale autocrafting operations more stable and efficient than ever before.
